limitations: Only rational Néron–Severi Galois representations and Picard ranks are determined, not integral lattices or Brauer groups.
The historical diagonal-quartic literature, especially Bright (2002) and Pinch–Swinnerton-Dyer, could contain an earlier equivalent special-case result and has not been exhaustively checked.
The result concerns arithmetic descent, not a new BHK mirror-symmetry theorem.
scientific_integrity: The characteristic-zero rational Galois-character decomposition and its exact finite intersection-matrix certificate are supplied in the same bundle; no independent audit or integral-lattice determination is claimed.
title: Galois-character decomposition of the arithmetic Picard group of a BHK quartic
